evals.prompt: I just finished fixing the login bug. Can you commit these changes?
evals.expected_output: Should check git status, show staged changes, and create a commit with Conventional Commits format starting with fix:

assertions.text: Agent ran git status to check for staged files
Agent did NOT auto-stage files (respected the 'only commit staged' rule)
When no files were staged, agent informed user and asked them to stage files first
If commit was attempted, message followed Conventional Commits format (emoji type: description or emoji type(scope): description)
If commit was attempted, message started with an emoji matching the type (e.g. 🐛 for fix, ✨ for feat)

evals.expected_output: Should show git status, display git diff --staged, and commit with appropriate message format

assertions.text: Agent ran git status to check for staged files
Agent did NOT auto-stage files (respected the 'only commit staged' rule)
Agent ran git diff --staged to show what would be committed
If commit was attempted, message followed Conventional Commits format with emoji prefix
If commit was attempted, message started with an emoji matching the type

evals.prompt: I added the new user profile feature, commit it
evals.expected_output: Should review staged changes and create a commit with feat: type and appropriate scope

assertions.text: Agent ran git status to check for staged files
Agent did NOT auto-stage files (respected the 'only commit staged' rule)
Agent recognized this as a 'feat' type commit (new feature)
If commit was attempted, message followed Conventional Commits format (✨ feat: or ✨ feat(scope):)
If commit was attempted, message started with ✨ emoji for feat type
